title: Tasks
subtitle: Northwind Bakery's team space in Tasklet, as Ana Lima. Five seeded tasks spread over overdue, this week, later and no date so every filter has results.

lanes.title: Create a task and assign it
lanes.desc: New task asks for title, due date and assignee. The task appears at the top of the list and the assignee gets an e-mail.

lanes.title: Filter tasks by due date
lanes.desc: Chips filter the list: all, due this week, overdue, assigned to me. The filter lives in the URL, so a filtered view can be shared.
